name: Vector Quantization for Time-Varying Fields
aliases: Vector Quantization for Time-Varying Data (Bernardon et al.)
Vector Quantization for Time-Varying Fields (Bernardon et al.)
definition: A technique extending vector quantization to encode scalar fields based on temporal coherence in a hierarchical data structure for time-varying unstructured grids.
summary: Vector Quantization for Time-Varying Fields is a compression technique that encodes scalar fields on unstructured grids by exploiting temporal coherence, distinguishing itself from static methods through dynamic decoding with minimal rendering overhead.
